concepts.gloss_en: To raise/elevate the (divine) honor — here via Torah of chesed (learning in order to teach)
To raise the honor AND the kingship (away) from them — a distinct act, effected via tzedakah, of rescuing honor+malchut from those who hold them

members.note: Shares the verb 'raise the honor' but has a different, expanded object (כבוד AND מלכות) and a source-of-removal ('from them'); different Torah, different mechanism (tzedakah vs Torah of chesed). Rule 4: distinct construct/scope — keep separate.

notes: Token overlap only on 'להעלות את הכבוד'. Second form adds 'והמלכות מהם' and belongs to a different Torah/context; not identity.
